input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new Windows export tool almost certainly writes CRLF line endings. `parseStatement` splits the input only on `"\n"`, leaving a trailing `"\r"` on every line, including the header. That turns the last header column into `"description\r"`, which no longer matches the expected `"description"` in `REQUIRED_COLUMNS`, so `assertShape` treats the header itself as malformed and throws `errors.rowShape` for row 1 every time — exactly the symptom reported. The parser needs to strip `\r` (e.g. handle `\r\n` line endings explicitly) before splitting fields.
